title: Apple's 50-year journey from garage to tech titan
title_zh: 苹果从车库到科技巨头的 50 年历程
summary: In early 1976 in California, Steve Wozniak had just completed the design of a computer circuit board he intended to share with fellow hobbyists at a prominent local club.
summary_zh: 1976 年初，史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克 (Steve Wozniak) 在加利福尼亚州刚刚完成了计算机电路板的设计，他打算与当地一家著名俱乐部的业余爱好者分享。

title: Microsoft, Chevron and Engine No. 1 sign exclusive deal for power supply
title_zh: 微软、雪佛龙和一号引擎签署独家电源协议
summary: Microsoft, Chevron and investment fund Engine No. 1 have entered into an exclusivity agreement ‌for power generation and supply, the three companies ‌said on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 微软、雪佛龙和投资基金 Engine No. 1 周二表示，已签订发电和供应独家协议。

title: Stock market today: Dow S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb as de-escalation talk in Iran sparks rally to close out Q1
title_zh: 今日股市：道指标普 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨，因伊朗局势缓和谈判引发反弹，结束第一季度
summary: Hope for equities is building as Iran and the US appear to be winding down aggressive rhetoric while markets seek stability.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗和美国似乎逐渐减少激进言论，同时市场寻求稳定，股市的希望正在增强。

title: Tesla Q1 deliveries rise 9% amid Robotaxi focus
title_zh: 特斯拉第一季度交付量增长 9%，聚焦 Robotaxi
summary: Yahoo Finance senior autos reporter Pras Subramanian joins Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton to discuss expectations for Tesla's ((TSLA) Q1 global deliveries.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 与 Asking for a Trend 主持人 Josh Lipton 一起讨论了对特斯拉 (TSLA) 第一季​​度全球交付量的预期。

title: OpenAI valued at $852 billion in latest funding round ahead of IPO
title_zh: OpenAI 在 IPO 前的最新一轮融资中估值达 8520 亿美元
summary: OpenAI announced its latest funding round on Tuedsay, raising $122 billion at a $852 billion valuation.
summary_zh: OpenAI 在周二宣布了最新一轮融资，筹集了 1220 亿美元，估值为 8520 亿美元。

title: Amazon partners up with Delta to provide high-speed internet
title_zh: 亚马逊与达美航空合作提供高速互联网
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley talks to Market Domination Host Josh Lipton about a recently announced partnership between Delta Air Lines (DAL) and Amazon (AMZN) to use Amazon's Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to provide internet access on flights.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与《市场支配》主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 讨论了达美航空 (DAL) 和亚马逊 (AMZN) 最近宣布的合作伙伴关系，将使用亚马逊的低地球轨道 (LEO) 卫星在航班上提供互联网接入。

title: Nvidia investors just had a surprising first quarter
title_zh: 英伟达投资者刚刚度过了令人惊讶的第一季度
summary: It's been a rough start to the year for the often-Teflon stock that is Nvidia.
summary_zh: 对于英伟达这样的特氟龙股票来说，今年的开局并不顺利。

title: Stock market today: Dow soars 1,000 points, S&P 500 and Nasdaq surge in upbeat end to brutal quarter
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数飙升 1,000 点，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数在残酷的季度结束时上涨
summary: Stocks turned sharply higher on Tuesday afternoon as investors became hopeful that an end to the war be may coming closer while a volatile month and quarter for stocks draws to a close.
summary_zh: 周二下午，随着股市波动的月份和季度即将结束，投资者对战争可能即将结束抱有希望，股市大幅走高。

title: Q1's final trading day: A recap of market moves this quarter
title_zh: 第一季度最后交易日：本季度市场走势回顾
summary: To wrap up the final trading day of the first quarter, Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at how stocks, sectors, and indexes have performed this quarter.
summary_zh: 为了结束第一季度的最后一个交易日，雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 回顾了本季度股票、板块和指数的表现。
